jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Analyst – Product Data & AI Quality
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online. 
Our unique data and solutions empower thousands of customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies.
In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.
We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our R&D department!
Why is this role so important at Similarweb?
Our Retail Intelligence products help leading brands and retailers understand how their products, brands and categories perform online. Behind them is data collected from retailers and marketplaces around the world, each describing products in its own way. We use LLMs and ML models to classify, normalize and structure that data into a single, trusted view.
As a Data Analyst on the team, you’ll be the person who knows this data best. You’ll own its quality: defining what “correct” looks like, building the ground truth our models are measured against, and finding where things break and why. You’ll work closely with the engineers and scientists who build our LLM and ML pipelines, and with Product, turning what you find into clear priorities. Your work will also directly support our customers: partnering with our customer-facing teams on deep-dive analyses, and investigating and fixing the data gaps that matter most to clients.
It’s a role for someone curious and hands-on, who enjoys digging into data, uses AI tools to move faster, and wants to see their analysis directly shape the product.
So, what will you be doing all day?
Your daily responsibilities may include:
- Analyzing product, brand and category data to find gaps, errors and opportunities to improve coverage and accuracy
- Defining quality metrics and building the dashboards and checks that track them over time
- Building and maintaining ground-truth datasets and labeling guidelines, and running labeling processes
- Evaluating the output of LLM and ML models: error analysis, comparing approaches, and turning findings into concrete improvements
- Using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analysis, labeling and data review
- Helping define and maintain taxonomies and classification rules together with Product
- Supporting client-related needs with our customer-facing teams, from in-depth analyses of specific market segments to investigating and fixing data gaps raised by clients
- Validating new data sources before they are added to the product
- Partnering with Product and engineering to translate findings into requirements and priorities
This is the perfect job for someone who:
- Holds a B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or another quantitative field
- Has 2+ years of experience as a data analyst, preferably in a tech company
- Has strong SQL skills
- Uses Python for data analysis (pandas, notebooks) - Must
- Has a solid understanding of statistics and evaluation metrics: sampling, precision/recall, confidence levels
- Has hands-on experience using LLMs for data work, such as prompting, structured outputs or reviewing model outputs
- Has strong attention to detail and a structured approach to messy, ambiguous data
- Communicates clearly in English and can present findings to Product, engineering and customer-facing teams
- Has experience with labeling, taxonomies or data quality processes (advantage)
- Has experience with e-commerce or product data (advantage)
- Has experience with BI and visualization tools (advantage)
At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in-office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.
Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:
You’ll actually love the product you work with: Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.
You’ll find a home for your big ideas: We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.
We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.
You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.
Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
At Similarweb, we’re revolutionizing how businesses understand the digital world by showing them everything that happens online. Our unique data and solutions empower over 13,000 customers worldwide including Google, eBay, and Adidas — to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. We went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021, and we’re still reaching new heights! Come join Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and genuinely good people.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Product Analyst to join our team and act as a central pillar between our data, our product, and our business strategy.
This isn’t a role for someone who just wants to answer tickets. You will be embedded with Product Managers and Growth leaders to not only provide data but to help shape the roadmap and influence how we build, launch, and monetize our products. We are looking for an analyst with a "business partner" mindset, someone who can look at a dataset and see the commercial opportunity or the user friction point before others do.
What You’ll Do
- Strategic Partnership: Work alongside PMs and leadership to define success metrics for new features and long-term growth initiatives.
- Full-Funnel Ownership: Design and measure KPIs across the entire user journey, from initial activation to complex monetization and retention loops.
- Proactive Discovery: Conduct deep-dives to uncover hidden bottlenecks. You won't just report on what happened; you'll recommend what we should do next.
- Narrative Building: Translate complex technical data into clear, "bottom-line first" narratives that drive action across the company.
- Cross-Functional Support: Act as the analytical bridge, supporting multiple product domains and ensuring a consistent, data-driven approach to every decision.
What We’re Looking For
- SaaS Experience: At least 2 years of experience as an analyst within a SaaS environment. You understand the core levers of a subscription business (ARR, Churn, PLG etc).
- Technical Versatility: High proficiency in SQL and experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.). You are comfortable picking up new tools and datasets quickly.
- Commercial Intuition: You have a natural ability to connect user behavior to business outcomes. You understand that data is only valuable if it leads to a decision.
- Drive & Curiosity: You are a self-starter who takes extreme ownership. You don't wait for the "perfect" brief; you dig in and find the answers.
- Strong Communicator: You can present technical findings to non-technical stakeholders in a way that is clear, persuasive, and insightful.
- Degree: B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Why You’ll Love Being a Similarwebber
- Impact: Your work will influence both product and business strategy across our global customer base.

jobs.title: Ad Operation Specialist
jobs.description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company! 
As an Ad Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting Taboola's advertising business by ensuring the seamless execution, monitoring, and delivery of digital video advertising campaigns. Working closely with Enterprise Account Managers, agencies, and cross-functional teams, you will help drive campaign success by proactively monitoring campaign delivery, identifying issues, preparing operational reports, and ensuring operational excellence across a high-volume portfolio.
This role requires a strong analytical mindset, exceptional attention to detail, and a customer-first approach. You will collaborate with Product, Support, R&D, and Business teams to resolve campaign-related challenges while becoming a trusted expert in Taboola's advertising platforms and operational workflows. Success in this role requires ownership, adaptability, strong communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
To thrive in this role, you'll need:
- 2+ years of experience in Ad Operations, Campaign Operations, Media Operations, or the AdTech industry.
- B.E. or B.Tech. degree in Computer Science or another graduate equivalent stream
- Hands-on experience working with advertising platforms such as Google Ad Manager (DFP), FreeWheel, DV360, SSPs, DSPs, or similar ad serving platforms.
- Strong understanding of digital advertising terminology, including impressions, CTR, CPM, CPA, conversions, pacing, and campaign delivery.
- Experience monitoring and managing live advertising campaigns.
- Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
- Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, including experience preparing operational reports.
- High level of English, both written and spoken.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong customer orientation with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external partners.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver with flawless execution.
- Willingness to work rotational shifts as required.
Bonus points if you have:
- Experience working with video advertising campaigns.
- Experience with CTV advertising.
- Experience working on the publisher side of the advertising ecosystem.
- Familiarity with Google Ad Manager (DFP), FreeWheel, or DV360.
- Experience working directly with advertising agencies and media planners.
How you’ll make an impact:
As an Ad Operation Specialist, you’ll bring value by: 
- Executing day-to-day operational activities related to digital advertising campaigns while ensuring accurate and timely campaign delivery.
- Monitoring live campaigns and proactively identifying delivery or performance issues.
- Reviewing campaign metrics such as impressions, CTR, CPA, conversions, and pacing, and communicating campaign status to internal stakeholders.
- Working closely with Enterprise Account Managers to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction throughout the campaign lifecycle.
- Collaborating with Product, Support, R&D, and Business teams to resolve campaign-related issues and improve operational efficiency.
- Communicating directly with agencies and external partners regarding campaign timelines, creative assets, delivery requirements, and campaign status.
- Preparing daily and ad hoc reports to support business decisions and customer communication.
- Becoming a subject matter expert on Taboola's advertising platforms and operational workflows while continuously identifying opportunities to improve operational excellence.
Why Taboola?
If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:
- Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.
- Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401k matching), pre-tax commuter benefits, a fully stocked kitchen, and various gym partnerships.
- Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.
- Work with some of the biggest names: We work with some of the biggest names in the business. Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, Expedia and Honda.
Ready to realize your potential?
Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.
Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. jobs.title: Assistant Controller - Corporate Team- 2908

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Associate
jobs.description:
Description
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that uses runtime context to identify and prioritize the risks that actually matter. With eBPF-powered sensors, we deliver agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security, so teams can focus on what truly matters instead of drowning in alerts.
We’re in a period of significant growth. There’s an enormous amount to build, improve, and shape, and every hire changes the trajectory of the company.
About the Role
 We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Associate: a sharp, curious Talent Acquisition professional at the start of their career who wants to learn the craft properly, from the inside of a fast-growing company.
This is a real Talent Acquisition role. You’ll run hiring processes end to end, from the first search to the signed offer, starting with early-career and less complex roles and growing into a full desk of your own. Alongside that, you’ll own part of the recruiting coordination that keeps our process running smoothly. You’ll be part of a professional, global team across Israel, EMEA, and APJ, with plenty of experienced people to learn from.
No prior recruiting experience is required. What matters is how you think, how you work, and how badly you want to get good at this.
What You’ll Do
- Own the full recruiting cycle for a portfolio of roles: opening intake with hiring managers, sourcing, screening, managing the interview process, and closing.
- Source proactively: build searches on LinkedIn and other platforms, use AI-assisted sourcing tools, reach out directly, and keep your own pipelines warm.
- Run hiring for early-career and less complex roles, from sourcing to scheduling to offers.
- Work closely with hiring managers: understand what they actually need, keep them updated, and bring them honest market feedback.
- Give every candidate a clear, warm, well-managed experience from the first message to the final answer, including the ones who don’t get an offer.
- Own recruiting coordination: scheduling, ATS hygiene, candidate communication, and keeping every process moving without things falling through the cracks.
- Track your pipelines and report on progress, and help us find ways to run things better.
- Learn fast: take part in intake sessions, calibration conversations, and process improvements, and gradually take on more complex roles.
Requirements
What We’re Looking For
Must-have
- A degree with strong academic results (or equivalent achievements).
- Fluent English, written and spoken. Native level is a plus. Hebrew fluency as well.
- Real hunger to build a career in recruiting, with the drive to prove it.
- Curiosity and sharpness: you ask good questions, challenge assumptions, and learn from every conversation.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust quickly with candidates and managers.
- Organization and attention to detail. You can juggle many open processes without dropping any.
- Comfort with technology and a genuine interest in AI-assisted tools.
Nice-to-have
- Experience in recruiting, HR, sales, or any role that involved talking to people and following through (including student jobs, military service, or volunteering).
- Interest in the tech and cybersecurity world.
- Experience with an ATS or sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter.
What You’ll Get
- Hands-on mentorship from experienced tech recruiting leaders.
- A real career path: from supporting roles and coordination to owning your own full-cycle desk.
- A front-row seat to a company in hypergrowth, where your work has visible impact from day one.

jobs.title: EFA Specialist
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte is looking for an Engagement Financial Advisor (EFA) to support the financial management of client engagements from inception to completion.
The role combines financial analysis, project controlling, forecasting, billing and collection (client-facing), and business partnering with engagement leaders to drive profitability and financial performance.
Key Responsibilities:
- Manage project budgeting, pricing, forecasting, and financial performance.
- Monitor revenue, profitability, utilization, and DSO metrics (plan vs. actual).
- Prepare and analyze financial reports to identify red flags and delivery insights for Partners and engagement leaders.
- Provide financial guidance and recommendations to improve project economics.
- Manage billing processes, collections, and financial reconciliations including interface with external clients and their payment systems.
- Ongoing interface with project leaders and finance teams.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field.
- Experience in finance, controlling, budgeting, or financial analysis.
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
- Advanced Excel proficiency; SAP experience is an advantage.
- Experience working with senior stakeholders in at least a medium-size organization.
- Ability to work independently and manage priorities
- Experience and/or ability to work with AI tools – mandatory
- Fluent Hebrew and strong English skills.

Deloitte מחפשת Engagement Financial Advisor (EFA) לתמיכה בניהול הפיננסי של התקשרויות מול לקוחות, משלב ההקמה ועד לסיום הפרויקט.

jobs.title: Finance & Billing Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte, the world's leading professional services firm, is looking for a Finance & Billing Transformation Consultant.
In this role, you will work with clients to improve finance, billing, and revenue processes through technology and AI solutions. You will help identify business challenges, gather requirements, and support the implementation of innovative finance transformation solutions across various industries.
Key Responsibilities
- Manage finance transformation projects, including scope, timelines, deliverables and coordination with stakeholders.
- Analyze finance, billing, revenue, and operational processes to identify inefficiencies and recommend technology-driven improvements.
- Collaborate with finance, revenue operations, billing operations, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and design scalable solutions.
- Work closely with clients to optimize Order-to-Cash (O2C), Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Billing-to-Revenue, and Revenue Operations processes.
- Support the implementation and configuration of finance technology platforms, including ERP, CPQ, billing, and revenue management systems.
- Translate complex business requirements into functional and technical specifications.
- Assess existing finance and operational workflows and identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and emerging technologies.
- Support the design and deployment of AI-enabled solutions that improve operational efficiency, reporting, and decision-making.
- Partner with cross-functional teams including Finance, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, IT, and Product teams to drive transformation initiatives.
- Develop process documentation, training materials, and best-practice recommendations to support successful solution adoption.
- Stay up to date with leading practices in Finance Transformation, SaaS operations, Billing, CPQ, Revenue Management, and AI technologies.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 1-3 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Billing Operations, Finance Transformation, or Financial Systems.
- Strong understanding of accounting, billing, revenue, or finance processes.
- Experience working in a finance department, preferably in a large technology or SaaS company.
- Experience with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Billing Operations, CPQ, Order-to-Cash, or Revenue Recognition processes – Advantage.
- Familiarity with ERP systems and financial platforms (such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora, etc.) – Advantage.
- Strong technological orientation and interest in working with innovative systems and AI solutions.
- Experience and/or ability to work with AI tools – mandatory
- Fluent English communication skills.
- Highly motivated, proactive, and capable of managing multiple projects and deadlines.
- Willingness to work flexible hours to support projects with global teams.

jobs.title: Project Manager  – Compliance, Privacy & Technology Governance
jobs.description:
Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Project Manager – Compliance, Privacy & Technology Governance to lead projects across the domains of Compliance, Privacy, Regulation, Ethics, Information Security, and AI Governance.
In this role, you will lead cross-functional projects and processes, collaborating closely with legal, business, and technology interfaces.
﻿Key Responsibilities:
Project Leadership: Manage and lead end-to-end projects in the fields of compliance, privacy, regulation, ethics, information security, and risk management.
Privacy Verification & Reviews: Lead Privacy Verification and Privacy Review processes for products, systems, projects, and technological initiatives; this includes identifying privacy risks, documenting requirements, and tracking mitigation progress until full closure.
CIMP Process Management: Manage and lead CIMP (Confidential Information Management Program) processes for technological products and solutions, including AI-based systems, while evaluating privacy, confidentiality, data usage, information security, and regulatory compliance.
AI Governance & Risk: Support AI-driven initiatives and products regarding Privacy, Compliance, Confidentiality, and Risk, as part of AI Governance and risk management throughout the product lifecycle.
Ethics & Anti-Corruption Programs: Develop, implement, and manage internal processes to prevent corruption, bribery, and ethical violations across the organization.
Policy Formulation: Draft, implement, and manage organizational policies and procedures concerning compliance, ethics, Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABC), privacy, and confidentiality.
Confidentiality & Data Protection Control: Oversee and control confidentiality processes and the protection of sensitive data, including reviewing confidentiality requirements in projects, products, and third-party engagements.
AML & Risk Monitoring: Monitor and control the implementation of AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and risk management processes, ensuring alignment with international regulatory standards.
Reporting & Training: Prepare comprehensive reports, working papers for executive management, privacy and compliance documentation, supervisory audit reports, and training programs.
Internal Audits: Conduct internal audits to identify, monitor, and mitigate compliance, privacy, confidentiality, ethics, and corruption risks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Manage active working interfaces with Legal, Privacy, Information Security, IT, Product, Development, Operations, Regulation, and business stakeholders.
Tech-Driven PM Tools: Utilize advanced technological tools for project and process management, with an emphasis on Monday.com.
Requirements
- professional Experience: Proven experience in Compliance, Regulation, Privacy, Risk Management, or Project Management – Required.
- Experience and/or ability to work with AI tools – mandatory.
- Privacy & Information Security Knowledge: Solid understanding and experience in privacy and information security, including familiarity with relevant regulations such as GDPR and local privacy laws – Required (Significant Advantage).
- Privacy Risk Assessments: Experience or familiarity with PIA (Privacy Impact Assessment) or Privacy Review processes, and assessing privacy risks in products, systems, or processes – Significant Advantage.
- GRC & CIMP Familiarity: Familiarity with CIMP (Confidential Information Management Program) and/or GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) processes for technological products and solutions – Significant Advantage.
- AI Governance & Privacy: Familiarity with Privacy & AI Governance, including privacy, confidentiality, data usage, and risk management in AI-based products – Significant Advantage.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with IT, Product, Engineering, Information Security, and/or R&D teams – Advantage.
- Data Protection & Third-Party Risks: Familiarity with confidentiality processes, protection of sensitive data, and privacy considerations in third-party engagements – Advantage.
- Project Leadership: Strong ability to manage and lead complex projects with both internal and external stakeholders.
- Analytical Skills: Excellent risk analysis capabilities, strong attention to detail, and a proven track record of tracking processes and tasks through to full closure.
- Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
- Interpersonal Dynamics: Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Language Proficiency: High-level English proficiency – Required.
Location: Tel Aviv
We at Deloitte believe that diversity and inclusion among our people is a critical component of our success, which is why we cultivate an organizational culture that embraces diversity in all its forms.

אנחנו מגייסים מנהל/ת פרויקטים לתחומי הציות, הפרטיות, הרגולציה, האתיקה, אבטחת המידע ו-AI Governance.
התפקיד כולל הובלת פרויקטים ותהליכים רוחביים מול ממשקים משפטיים, עסקיים וטכנולוגיים.

● ניהול והובלת תהליכי CIMP עבור מוצרים ופתרונות טכנולוגיים, לרבות פתרונות מבוססי AI, תוך בחינת היבטי פרטיות, סודיות, שימוש במידע, אבטחת מידע וציות לדרישות רגולטוריות.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Description
At Natural Intelligence, we are on a mission to simplify decision-making for millions. We build leading comparison websites that connect high-intent consumers with the world's top brands. Since 2009, we've grown into a bootstrapped, profitable powerhouse in the performance marketing industry.
Now, we're looking for a Product Operations Manager to help us connect Product and Business teams and drive operational excellence across our websites and cross-functional initiatives.
The Day-to-Day
You will play a key role in connecting Product and Business teams, driving alignment between product priorities and business objectives while providing operational expertise across product-related initiatives. This includes owning and driving cross-functional Product and Business OKRs, collaborating with stakeholders across the organization, and taking hands-on responsibility for building, managing, and maintaining the company's websites.
A key part of the role is to continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency, simplify workflows, and strengthen operational processes. You will proactively introduce innovative solutions, including AI-powered tools and technologies, to automate repetitive work, optimize processes, and enable teams to work smarter and more effectively.
Your Impact
- Coordinate cross-functional execution across Product, Business, R&D, Content, and Design, ensuring clear ownership and delivery.
- Align Business and Product teams around priorities, requirements, and delivery timelines.
- Partner with Product Managers to translate product strategy into actionable initiatives and execution plans.
- Lead the rollout of new and existing product capabilities, ensuring operational readiness and smooth deployment.
- Build, manage, and maintain company websites across multiple platforms, ensuring operational excellence and continuous improvement.
- Create and analyze user segments and A/B tests to support data-driven decision-making.
- Manage cross-unit projects, overseeing timelines, scope, dependencies, and quality.
- Proactively identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, streamline workflows, and develop scalable solutions by leveraging AI, automation, and innovative approaches.
Requirements
- 2+ years of relevant professional experience in similar roles (Product Operations, Project Management, Business Operations, etc)
- Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, project management, and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills
- Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented
- Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and leverage AI and automation to increase efficiency
- Bachelor’s degree
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)
*Only suitable CVs will be considered.
﻿Why You’ll Love Working Here
- You won't just hear about AI, you’ll have the best cutting-edge tools at your fingertips to do your best work.
- Our stunning ToHa Tel Aviv offices come with a fully-equipped gym, a music room, amazing coffee, and views for days.
- Come exactly as you are: We're proud to be 52% women, with incredibly vibrant internal communities (Olim, LGBTQ+, Parents, and more).
- Competitive pay and growth paths are key, but it’s the everyday vibe that makes the difference. We love gathering for great happy hours, team offsites, and celebrating our milestones together.
Think you're a natural fit? Join us!
Before you hit apply, take a quick look at the requirements to ensure this role aligns with your experience. We carefully review applications, but due to high volumes, we will only be in touch if there's a strong fit. We appreciate your time!
Natural Intelligence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on talent and potential, welcoming applicants from all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations available upon request at equal.employment@naturalint.com.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Security
jobs.description:
Description
About Cyera
Come join the company building the security operating model for the age of AI.
AI has changed how data is used - and security must change with it. Cyera's mission is to empower businesses to accelerate AI Adoption by defining a holistic approach to securing AI - from data to access to model. Instead of perimeter controls and static policies, Cyera provides a unified control plane that understands relationships between data, access, and behaviors across humans, systems, and AI. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data and AI security.
About the Role
Earlier this year, Cyera established an entirely new group with a singular focus: Enabling our customers to safely adopt AI. Not just secure AI use after the fact - but discover it, govern it, and protect it end to end.
You'll join this group as we define what enterprise-grade AI security looks like from scratch. The work spans detection and classification of AI usage across the enterprise, governance frameworks for AI agents and models, and the controls that let security teams move as fast as the technology they're protecting against. The market is moving fast - new models, new attack surfaces, new regulatory pressures, new customer needs - and keeping up isn't optional. You'll need to live at the edge of what's happening, synthesize signal from noise, and turn it into product decisions before others have even framed the question.
This is a rare role: Deeply strategic, deeply technical, and deeply consequential.
﻿What You’ll Do
- You'll own product initiatives across the AI security lifecycle - from how enterprises discover AI sprawl across their environments, to how they govern AI agent behavior, to how they enforce data protection in a world where models are the new attack surface. 
- You'll work across the full spectrum - partnering with world-class R&D teams pushing the boundaries of what's technically possible, engaging CISOs and security architects at Fortune 500 companies globally to understand real-world constraints, and collaborating with GTM to translate customer needs into product direction. The environment is fast, sometimes chaotic, and genuinely exciting - the kind of place where the problem space shifts under your feet and that's a feature, not a bug.
Requirements
Who You Are
Must-Haves
- You have a strong track record in B2B product management - ideally in security, data, or enterprise SaaS - but specific knowledge of any of these domains is less critical than authentic curiosity and a proven track record of building great products in a dynamic environment.
- Exceptional product taste and passion for creating delightful product experiences.
- You understand how large organizations actually operate: The compliance pressures, the procurement cycles, the gap between what security teams want and what they can deploy.
- You have a clear point of view on AI and where enterprise security is headed.
- You're as comfortable in a whiteboard session with an enterprise architect as you are deep in a research paper because something just dropped that changes everything.
- You thrive on ambiguity, move with urgency, and find energy in the pace rather than fighting it.
- You are excited about the opportunity to join a team of high performers in a high pressure environment and take an active role in contributing to the success of Cyera and our customers.
﻿Why Join Us?
At Cyera, we own what we build and how we work. Cyerans are empowered to take initiative, move quickly, and turn ideas into impact.
We push boundaries by challenging the status quo, learning fast, and continuously raising the bar - for ourselves and for the industry.
We elevate together by lifting each other up, celebrating wins as a team, and recognizing that our success is shared.
Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.
We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: NPI Engineering Build Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an NPI Engineering Build Manager who is passionate about working on products that enable deep learning. Our team manages the NPI networking supply chain for engineering activities. Activities start from very early engagement with design engineering team and follow through all quick turn NPI builds at the shortest possible cycle time. Our team supports all these engineering quick turn activities by engaging with the engineering team, material suppliers, Operations team, and the PCB manufacturing team. All the parties need to be kept aligned while engineering keeps changing either the material sets or the process.
We are looking for someone can work in a dynamic and fast-changing environment. You are someone who enjoys working on groundbreaking technology and enjoy working with people to take on problems. As a Build Project Manager, you are able to see both the high-level view and be proficient in tracking and following up on detail whether it is an existing product that requires new qualifications or a ground up new product. We will expect you to understand technical detail and be able to translate that into program impact.
What you'll be doing:
Build project's production plan per product's lifecycle, and execute it with NV manufacturers
Communicate with other team members and suppliers to get project details, and flexibility to adapt to changing requirements, diverse project needs, and tight timelines.
Ability to report on program details in Alignment meetings.
Track and communicate key deliverables, constraints, risks, dependencies and clearly identify critical paths while working with ASIC, product, test, software, board, system engineering and planning teams and other program managers towards a common goal.
Manage cross-functional communications independently, work within a matrixed and publish progress/roadblocks and highlight risks to upper management.
Bring diverse and globally distributed teams together to tackle complex problems and work towards closure.
Lead and attend cross-functional NPI meetings related to your product and highlight key Ops issues while ensuring that the product is ready for production.
Be an active participant in the NPI team by recommending methodology improvements that we can practice as a team.
Requirements: 
 What we need to see:
B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, or equivalent experience.
2+ years experience in a similar role, preferably within an engineering, manufacturing/operations environment.
Ability to track multiple projects simultaneously.
Good interpersonal skills are important to your success and knowing when to engage stakeholders for making decisions or resolving issues.
Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, decision-making, and cross-functional influencing skills.
Ability to analyze and solution supply chain processes.
Excellent knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing flow and processes with proven program management capability.
Concise and actionable communications are also important.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Prior experience in semiconductor, interconnect, board, or system NPI.
Working knowledge of SAP.
Strong collaborative and social skills, and ability to effectively guide and influence within a dynamic, multifaceted environment.
Multifaceted environment.
This position is open to all candidates.

Youll be the main connection between our business units and R&D - understanding business needs, translating them into clear requirements, aligning priorities, and helping teams deliver successfully. Youll also support product and project activities to move initiatives forward.

Serve as the main point of contact between business stakeholders and R&D
Translate business needs into clear requirements and technical briefs
Work closely with R&D to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, and delivery expectations
Own development initiatives end-to-end spec, tasks, QA, rollout, and monitoring whether you build them yourself using AI tools, automation and no-code, or hand them to R&D developers.
Write technical specs and acceptance criteria, and manage the work in task management tools.
Guide and train the business departments on new features documentation, walkthroughs, and ongoing suport
Coordinate cross-functional meetings, updates, and ongoing communication
Assist in planning and prioritizing roadmaps and project timelines
Track and report on progress, risks, and blockers across multiple initiatives
Solve complex tech problems and support the business departments

jobs.title: Technical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a motivated and talented Technical Operations Manager to join our team. As a Technical Operations Manager you will work closely with our Product and Monetization teams to ensure the smooth running of all the events, promotions, marketing events and live A/B tests. You will be in charge of all related technical aspects to enable events and promotions both inside and outside the game.
Responsibilities
Manage the full lifecycle of features and events from technical readiness through release, QA, calendar scheduling, and post-publish monitoring.
Identify repetitive or manual steps in workflows and actively work to eliminate them using AI tools, scripts, and process redesign.
Act as the operational link between Product, Business, Engineering, and QA, ensuring smooth handoffs.
Take an active role in translating operational expertise into structured, AI-powered processes that extend the teams capabilities at scale.
Requirements: 
 2+ years as Automation Engineer / QA Automation roles.
Bsc in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems or similar field.
Ability to manage tasks efficiently across multiple platforms (Jira, Monday.com, or equivalents).
Self-driven and proactive, Self learner with a strong ability to identify and fix issues independently.
Capable of writing clear, complete, and actionable process guides and documentation.
Hands-on experience with AI workflow tools (Claude, Cowork, GPT-based tools, or similar)
Advantages
Experience with live game operations (events, A/B testing, publishing pipelines).
Familiarity with configuration-based systems.
Experience writing or improving operational SOPs.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: אחראי /ת פרויקטי גמר לתואר ראשון ביה"ס להנדסת תעשייה ומערכות נבונות
jobs.description:
ריכוז, ניהול ופיתוח פעילות פרויקטי הגמר בבית הספר, לרבות גיבוש תהליכי עבודה וליווי שוטף של כלל הגורמים המעורבים. ייזום, פיתוח וטיפוח קשרי עבודה ושיתופי פעולה עם גורמי חוץ בתעשייה, בארגוני שירות, במוסדות ציבוריים ובאקדמיה, לצורך איתור וקידום פרויקטים. בחינה, אישור והקצאת פרויקטים לסטודנטים ולמנחים, ומעקב אחר התקדמותם לאורך שלבי הביצוע השונים. קיום קשר שוטף עם מנחי הפרויקטים ועם אנשי הקשר בארגונים השותפים, ומתן מענה מקצועי ותפעולי בהתאם לצורך. ניהול ותפעול אתר הקורס ומעקב אחר פעילות צוותי הפרויקטים בהתאם למתודולוגיות העבודה שנקבעו. תכנון, ארגון וריכוז אירועי הצגת פרויקטי הגמר, לרבות ימי מצגות, תערוכות סוף שנה ואירועים פקולטיים. ייזום ימי מצגות סטודנטים, הרצאות אורח ופעילויות אקדמיות משלימות בתחום הפרויקטים. ייצוג בית הספר מול יחידות הפקולטה והאוניברסיטה וקידום שיתופי פעולה פנים-ארגוניים. ביצוע מטלות נוספות בהתאם להנחיית הממונים.
דרישות:
 תואר שני בהנדסה או במדעים מדויקים. תואר בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול - יתרון. היכרות עם התעשייה ויכולת לפתח ולקיים קשרי עבודה עם ארגונים רלוונטיים בתחומי הנדסת תעשייה ומערכות, בדגש על מערכות ביטחוניות, מערכות בריאות וארגונים מובילים במשק. ניסיון בהוראה, בהדרכה ו/או בליווי פרויקטים אקדמיים או מקצועיים - יתרון. יכולת ייזום, הובלת תהליכים ופיתוח שיתופי פעולה. יכולת עבודה עצמאית והשתלבות בצוות. ידיעת השפה העברית על בוריה וידיעת השפה האנגלית ברמה טובה מאד, לרבות יכולת הבעה ותכתובת בשפות אלה. יכולת למידה עצמית של נושאים מורכבים והתעדכנות מקצועית. יכולת ארגון, תכנון, תיאום ומעקב ברמה גבוהה. יכולת התמודדות עם עומס משימות ועמידה בלוחות זמנים. תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש מעולים. הערה: נדרשת נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות עפ"י הצורך. כפיפות: אחראי אקדמי של קורס הפרויקט ולראשת המינהל. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: הנדסאי/ת תעשייה וניהול - תפ"י
jobs.description:
הנדסאי/ת תעשייה וניהול לתפקיד תפי | עיבוד שבבי | אחריות על תכנון הייצור מקצה לקצה 
לחברה יצרנית בתחום העיבוד השבבי דרוש/ה איש תפי לתכנון ולבקרה של תהליכי הייצור, מקבלת הזמנת הלקוח ועד לאספקתה.
משרה מלאה באזור המרכז. לאחר שנה מתוכנן מעבר לקריית גת.
מה מייחד את התפקיד?
- אחריות רציפה על תוכנית הייצור לאורך מחזור ההזמנה.
- שילוב בין תכנון וניתוח נתונים לבין נוכחות קבועה ברצפת הייצור.
- עבודה מקצועית עם מנהל המפעל וממשקי טכנולוגיה, ייצור, איכות, רכש ולוגיסטיקה.
מה כולל התפקיד?
- הזנת הזמנות ודרישות אספקה למערכת, פתיחת פקודות עבודה ומעקב אחר ביצוען.
- הכנת תוכניות ייצור שבועיות וחודשיות בהתאם לעומסים ולסדרי העדיפויות.
- תזמון העבודה בין מחלקות החריטה, הכרסום, ההשחזה, הביקורת וההרכבה, ובין תהליכי הייצור החיצוניים.
- בקרה על התקדמות הייצור ביחס לתוכנית ועל זמינות חומרי גלם, כלים, מתקנים ותיקי ייצור.
- זיהוי חוסרים, עיכובים וצווארי בקבוק; מעקב אחר הזמנות פתוחות, הזמנות בפיגור והזמנות שבסיכון.
- מעקב אחר עבודות קבלני משנה ובקרה על מלאי חומרי הגלם, המלאי בתהליך והתוצרת המוגמרת.
- ריכוז וניתוח נתונים על זמני ייצור, תפוקות וניצולת מכונות.
- עבודה שוטפת מול מנהל המפעל, טכנולוגים, מנהלי מחלקות, איכות, רכש ולוגיסטיקה, כולל נוכחות ברצפת הייצור.
להגשת מועמדות לשלוח קוח למייל.
דרישות:
 מה נדרש?
- השכלת הנדסאי/ת תעשייה וניהול. ניתן לשקול גם מהנדס/ת תעשייה וניהול או השכלה רלוונטית אחרת עם ניסיון מתאים.
- התמחות במערכות ייצור - יתרון.
- ניסיון של כשנתיים לפחות בתפי בסביבה יצרנית.
- ניסיון בעיבוד שבבי או בייצור מורכב.
- ניסיון בתכנון תוכניות ייצור, בניהול עומסים ובמעקב אחר פקודות עבודה.
- ניסיון במערכות ERP /MRP ובמערכת קיטרון (Kitaron).
- שליטה טובה מאוד ב-Excel והבנת תהליכי ייצור ושרטוטים לצורכי תכנון ובקרה.
- יכולת לעבוד עם נתונים רבים, לטפל במספר משימות במקביל ולקבוע סדרי עדיפויות.
- עברית ברמה גבוהה ואנגלית טכנית טובה. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.description:
היקף המשרה : מלאה.
התפקיד כולל :

jobs.title: Applied AI & Data Science: מסלול קריירה ללא עלות בשיתוף רשות החדשנות כולל שילוב במשרה
jobs.location: אילת, ערד, ירושלים, אשדוד, לוד, פתח תקווה, רמת גן, אריאל
jobs.description:
מסלול ללא עלות הכולל שילוב במשרה, עוד במהלך ההכשרה.
מסלול הקריירה Applied AI & Data Science של אינפיניטי לאבס ורשות החדשנות, הוא מסלול אינטנסיבי ועמוק שבונה את היכולת המקצועית שלכם להיכנס לתפקיד בתעשייה. הסיבה שההשקעה משתלמת היא שהיכולת שלכם נבנית בהתאם לדרישות האמיתיות של התעשייה, ותהליך החיבור לחברות מתחיל עוד לפני סיום המסלול.
המטרה היא לא לסיים הכשרה או לקבל תעודה. אנחנו בונים אנשי AI שיודעים לחקור, לפתח, להתנסות, לקבל החלטות מקצועיות להתמודד עם בעיות חדשות - ואז משלבים אותם במשרה הראשונה שלהם בתחום. ההכשרה בת 30 שבועות, ללא עלות למתקבלים, ואנחנו מתחילים להרוויח רק כשאתם משתלבים במשרה.
Infinity Labs היא חברת R&D, לא מכללה או גוף קורסים. אנחנו עובדים עם יותר מ-300 חברות וארגונים, והמנטורים שלנו הם אנשי מחקר ופיתוח פעילים עם רקע עשיר. לכן המסלול נבנה מתוך מה שקורה בפועל ב-R&D ומה שנדרש מאנשי AI בתעשייה.
אנחנו מחפשים אנשים עם רקע מחקרי חזק, על מנת שנוכל להפוך את היכולת הזו לקריירה ב-AI.
דרישות:
 תואר ראשון בהנדסה / מדעים מדויקים / מדעי המחשב
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה
יכולת למידה עצמית גבוהה
אוריינטציה אנליטית
אין צורך בניסיון קודם
משרה מלאה, היברידית 
* המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

שלחו הודעה למייל
צרפו קורות חיים עם שם וטלפון. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager leads a cross-functional/multidisciplinary team of Leaders and their respective project teams for PET programs in Haifa, to deliver project objectives., The program manager drives clarity by continuously defining and prioritizing work, defines the critical success factors/deliverables for the team.
Job Description
Duties include (but are not limited to):
1. Overall responsibility for program success providing engineering innovation within time, budgetary, quality and performance constraints and guidance to continuously deliver products directly supporting the overall business strategy. 
2. Creates and ensures effective and efficient communication across business functions. 
3. Applies leadership to motivate and energize the variety of cross-functional teams consisting of the program. 
4. Works closely and transparently with Product Leadership and Business Leadership to align program with market dynamics and drive program direction.
5. Leads cross-functional and/or multi-disciplinary program planning, drives the team to generate trade-offs and identify and manage risks from the early planning phase, throughout the entire program execution. 
6. Works as an equal partner with the program team to deliver results, understands and openly supports all functional goals.
7. Solves complex and ambiguous problems, leads the strategic and forward-thinking program execution including (but not limited to) concept discussion, program execution, rollout, training, pilot trials, clinical evaluations until successful deployment to serial production. 
8. Works with customers to solicit input and feedback to meet quality and customer expectations.
9. Provides expert guidance and support to the program organization in various technical/functional aspects.
10. Creates and supports the stewardship of intellectual property with appropriate security of project documentation.
Requirements: 
 1. Bachelors Degree within appropriate Engineering/Science discipline with at least 2 years of cross-functional Project and/ or Technical Leadership experience.
2. Minimum of 5 years of experience in program management or project leadership of multi-disciplinary systems within a development, technical industry, manufacturing and/or research environment.
3. Demonstrated execution at meeting project goals while satisfying quality, performance, schedule, and budget CTQs.
4. Demonstrated engineering knowledge, program management, and business planning processes, having experience with the full product lifecycle from concept through end of life.
5. Familiarity with IEC, FDA EMC, and other regulatory standards.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Programme Controls Manager
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities and duties:
The Programme Controls Manager will lead areas of programme management. This person will manage project controls professionals covering scheduling, cost, forecasting, estimating, planning, digital strategies, database and document control functions. Specific responsibilities will include writing procedures and managing the delivery of key executive-level reports such as dashboard charts, construction progress checklists and monthly reports. This individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining project controls processes and systems on large projects and will include initial programme set up. Additionally, involvement in project and contract planning, issuance, scheduling, assessment, change negotiation, and claims mitigation/resolution may be required.
Requirements: 
 Professional engineer with 15 or more years experience in major infrastructure projects including mass transit.
Project controls experience in estimating, forecasting, scheduling, cost control, schedule control, and project reports.
Strong decision-making skills.
Known for excellent staff management, interpersonal and leadership expertise.
Ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple long- and short-term tasks simultaneously.
Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our team culture is a must.
Strong scheduling and PMIS background (preferred).
Bachelor's or similar academic degree, construction or engineering (preferred).
Certifications (one or more): PSP, PMP, PE, CM, EVP, PMI-SP, CST (preferred).
Ability to interpret construction schedules (preferred).
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Program Manager will ensure predictable, coordinated, and transparent delivery between Product and R&D, from release planning through launch. The role connects product and engineering teams, establishing effective ways of working, managing dependencies and priorities, and maintaining clear communication with relevant stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Lead release planning, readiness, and launch processes in close collaboration with Product and R&D teams.
Manage release plans and track release readiness, dependencies, blockers, risks, and delivery milestones.
Create, consolidate, and distribute clear and accurate release notes.
Facilitate sprint opening, ongoing tracking, and closure, including monitoring tasks, statuses, and delivery objectives.
Work closely with Engineering Team Leads, Product Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders across the company.
Support prioritization and alignment across business, product, and technical needs.
Establish and continuously improve operating processes, ceremonies, and tracking tools to enable efficient and predictable delivery.
Identify blockers, drive their resolution, and provide transparent updates on program and release progress.
Requirements: 
 Requirements
2-3 years of experience in project management or program management within an R&D or product environment.
Experience working with Agile methodologies and managing sprint cycles.
Hands-on experience with Jira and similar project tracking tools.
Strong ability to manage priorities, dependencies, and multiple stakeholders.
Excellent organizational, interpersonal communication, and process-driving skills.
Technical background and an understanding of software development processes.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a SaaS or B2B environment.
Experience leading Release Management processes.
A relevant degree, such as Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related field.
This position is open to all candidates.

 ניסיון בתפקידי קשרי דיירים, PMO, בקרה או שירות לקוחות מורכב - יתרון משמעותי.

 תודעת שירות גבוהה, יחסי אנוש מצוינים וסבלנות.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:

הזדמנות לייצר אימפקט משמעותי ולהשפיע על חוויית המפתחים בארגון גדול
התפקיד כולל הובלת מוצר מרכזי שמאפשר לדלוור מהר, יעיל ובסטנדרט גבוה- פורטל המפתחים.
זו הזדמנות נדירה להצטרף לCTO שמתפקד כמו סטרטאפ טכנולוגי לכל דבר ועניין. עבודה רוחבית עם גורמים עסקיים וטכנולוגיים רבים בארגון, בחינה מתמדת, הזרקה והטמעה של טכנולוגיות חדשות.
מהות התפקיד:
אחריות מקצה לקצה על פיתוח, דליברי וניהול מוצרים בפלטפורמת פורטל המפתחים.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
In this role, we are looking for a Go To Market (GTM) to own business growth and product strategy to support the rapid growth of our company. This includes owning the product go to market strategy for one of our product areas, creating compelling messaging and positioning, launching new features, enabling the field teams, and partnering with marketing and revenue to target the right buyers and influencers.
Responsibilities
Act as a business owner for your product area to measure and accelerate commercial success and product growth by owning launch execution, pipeline impact, and market expansion.
Define use cases, product messaging and positioning, value propositions, and customer profiles to showcase the value of our company.
Become a subject matter expert in cloud security with an in-depth understanding of the market and products, including overall value proposition, features, functionality, and the verticals and use cases in which they are relevant.
Partner closely with product management to ensure we are delivering on end to end scenarios that meet customer needs and to execute world class product and feature launches.
Develop tools and training to support the full sales cycle, including product demos, sales training, reference architectures, and competitive intelligence to the field and marketing organizations.
Define the strategic narrative for GTM and deliver key messages that enable our marketing team to execute high-quality digital and event-based campaigns and programs.
Work closely with our demand generation teams to drive the pipeline for the sales organization.
Requirements: 
 Degree in Computer Science, equivalent technical background, or hands-on technical experience.
Experience in product marketing, solutions engineering, or product management at an enterprise-focused software or SaaS company.
Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and core messaging skills in English.
Proven track record of driving product adoption, GTM strategy, and marketing for technical audiences with the ability to effectively engage security, cloud, and developer personas within enterprises.
Preferred qualifications
Prior experience working with major cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Experience in the cybersecurity industry.
Proven track record of leading end-to-end product and feature launches.
Demonstrated experience working closely with cross-functional sales and product teams.
Proven ability to think strategically, problem-solve, and execute independently.
Strong project management skills to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get scrappy in a startup environment.
This position is open to all candidates.

1 שנות ניסיון
תיאור משרה
אחריות על ניתוח והפקת מידע עסקי ממערכות הארגון, לצד יישום, תחזוקה ופיתוח של מערכת ה-CRM הארגונית.
התפקיד כולל עבודה מול ממשקים עסקיים וטכנולוגיים, אפיון צרכים, ניהול נתונים, בדיקות מערכת והפקת תובנות התומכות בקבלת החלטות.
. אנליזה וניתוח נתונים
• שליפת נתונים ממערכות החברה וממאגרי מידע שונים.
• בניית דוחות שוטפים ואד-הוק בהתאם לצרכים העסקיים.
• עיבוד, ניקוי וטיוב נתונים.
• הצגת ממצאים ותובנות להנהלה/
• תמיכה בקבלת החלטות באמצעות ניתוח נתונים והצגת המלצות.
. יישום וניהול מערכת CRM
• ניהול שוטף של מערכת ה-CRM ותמיכה במשתמשים.
• הגדרת תהליכים עסקיים במערכת.
• הקמה ותחזוקה של טבלאות, שדות, הרשאות וממשקים.
• אפיון דרישות עסקיות מול משתמשי המערכת.
• ליווי פיתוחים וביצוע בדיקות קבלה .
• בדיקות גרסאות חדשות והטמעת שינויים במערכת.
• זיהוי תקלות, תחקורן ועבודה מול גורמי פיתוח עד לפתרון.
• הדרכת משתמשים והטמעת תהליכי עבודה חדשים.
• שמירה על איכות ותקינות הנתונים במערכת
דרישות התפקיד
• תואר ראשון במערכות מידע, הנדסת תעשייה וניהול, כלכלה, סטטיסטיקה או תחום רלוונטי-חובה
• ניסיון קודם באנליזה עסקית וניתוח נתונים-חובה
• ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות CRM.-חובה
• שליטה גבוהה ב-Excel. חובה
• ניסיון בכתיבת SQL ושליפת נתונים ממאגרי מידע-חובה
• ניסיון בבדיקות מערכת ואפיון תהליכים עסקיים-חובה
• יכולת ניתוח והצגת מידע ברמה גבוהה-חובה
• ראייה מערכתית והבנה עסקית.
• יכולת עבודה עצמאית וניהול משימות מרובות.
• ניסיון במערכת Dynamics CRM / Salesforce / Monday CRM.
• ניסיון בעבודה עם Power BI.
• היכרות עם תהליכים פיננסיים, שירות או מכירות.
• ניסיון בעבודה מול ספקי תוכנה וצוותי פיתוח.
• חשיבה אנליטית ויכולת ירידה לפרטים.
• סדר וארגון ברמה גבוהה.
• יכולת למידה עצמית מהירה.
• שירותיות ויכולת עבודה מול מגוון ממשקים.
• יוזמה והובלת תהליכי שיפור
*מגדל מעודדת העסקת גברים/נשים עם מוגבלויות, ומנגישה את סביבת העבודה לצרכיהם/ן
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: אנליסט /ית דיגיטל ושיתופי פעולה מסחריים
jobs.location: תל אביב יפו, רמת גן, פתח תקווה, רעננה
jobs.description:
התפקיד כולל:
אחריות על ניתוח נתוני פעילות הדיגיטל, הסושיאל ושיתופי הפעולה המסחריים.
בקרה אחר נתוני הכנסות לרבות התאמות ואישורים מול מחלקת הכספים.
הפקת דוחות שוטפים, ביצוע ניתוחי עומק והסקת תובנות עסקיות לצורך קבלת החלטות והנעת פעולות.
הכנת מצגות ודוחות מבוססי נתונים והמלצות עבור גורמים עסקיים ולהנהלה.
זיהוי הזדמנויות לשיפור ביצועים, אופטימיזציה של תהליכים והגדלת הכנסות באמצעות ניתוח נתונים והצגת המלצות מבוססות מידע.
משרה מלאה בימים א'-ה' בין השעות 09:00-18:00, נדרשת זמינות לשעות נוספות לפי צורך.
מיקום: רמת החייל, תל אביב
דרישות:
 ניסיון של לפחות שנתיים בתפקיד דומה - חובה.
 היכרות עם עולם הסחר / מדיה - חובה.
שליטה מעולה באקסל - חובה. 
ניסיון כ-Digital Analysis - יתרון משמעותי.
 ניסיון בליווי פיתוח והטמעה של מערכות - יתרון. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: אנליסט.ית שיווק - מכרז חיצוני
jobs.description:

מהות התפקיד: אחריות על אנליזה שיווקית ותובנות עסקיות מבוססות דאטה

 בנייה ותיקוף מודלים מבוססי רווחיות לפעילות שיווקית ודיגיטלית
 שיתוף ממצאים ודיווח שוטף על הביצועים לחברת האם בחו"ל

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
a biotech company is looking for a Business Analyst
 Analyze sales, pricing, customer profitability, costs, and budgets, providing insights to support business decisions.
 Lead cost and profitability analysis across production and supply chain, including product costing, inventory analysis, and cost structures.
 Cross-functional collaboration with Production, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Finance teams to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and profitability.
 Own and support SAP controlling, costing, and pricing processes, ensuring accurate and reliable data.
 Partner with the Global Group Finance team on reporting, analysis, controls, and implementation of Group guidelines and standards.
 Support the CFO and senior management with financial and business analysis, management reports, and presentations.
 Support the annual budgeting
Requirements: 
 Education
 Bachelor's degree in economics / industrial engineering. 
 Master's degree in economics / accounting - an advantage.
Experience Skills
 Experience in budgeting, costing, and pricing within an industrial company, or in an accounting/financial consulting firm serving industrial clients.
 Experience working in an international business environment.
 SAP R/3 experience - an advantage.
 Advanced Excel skills with strong proficiency in data analysis and financial modeling.
 Excellent professional English; French - an advantage.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
As an FP&A Analyst at our company, youll be the go-to financial partner, fully embedded in the business units youre part of. Youll combine analytical rigor with strategic thinking, leveraging data and AI tools to translate financial data into insights that empower business leaders to make smarter, faster decisions. Youll collaborate closely with senior stakeholders to drive efficient planning and forecasting. In your day-to-day, you will: 
Build and maintain data-driven financial models and forecasts aligned with company goals and budget constraints 
Lead annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes, connecting financial plans to business priorities 
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, dashboards, and executive-level presentations 
Analyze actual vs. budget/forecast performance, identify key variances, and deliver clear, actionable insights to business leaders 
Own the month-end and quarter-end close processes, ensuring accuracy and consistency of financial data 
Leverage AI tools and automation to continuously improve planning and reporting - making processes faster, sharper, and more impactful as our company scales 
At our company, we believe our best work happens together. Our work model is fully in person, with 5 days a week from our office. Flexibility remains a core value at our company and special requests are handled thoughtfully at the team level.
Requirements: 
 2-3 years of experience as an FP&A Analyst, Finance Business Partner, or Data Analyst, preferably in a tech or high-growth environment 
Familiarity with AI tools and a data-driven mindset - you look for smarter ways to work, not just harder ones 
Curious and driven with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and a sharp attention to detail and data integrity 
Proven hands-on experience applying AI tools in finance workflows - automation, data validation, or forecasting improvements 
Strong collaboration and communication skills - youre comfortable translating complex data into clear insights and presenting to senior stakeholders 
Bachelors Degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field 
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; strong command of financial modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis 
Experience embedded in tech or high-growth organizations as a finance business partner - an advantage 
Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or similar 
Experience working with financial systems such as Oracle and TM1 (IBM).
This position is open to all candidates.

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a data driven mindset
Experience analysing acquisition funnels, campaign performance, traffic quality, and conversion metrics
Good understanding of digital acquisition channels, attribution, and performance marketing metrics
Excellent communication skills and ability to present insights to nontechnical stakeholders
Experience working in cross functional Agile environments
Advantage: experience in ecommerce, health tech, or telemedicine companies
This position is open to all candidates.

לחברה פיננסית גדולה באזור פתח תקווה דרוש/ה אנליסט/ת ומנהלת מטה 
*** נא לשלוח קוח בעברית ***
יכולת אנליטית וחשיבה עסקית גבוהה.,יכולת להפוך נתונים לתובנות ולהמלצות אופרטיביות..יכולת הנעת ממשקים ללא סמכות ישירה. יכולת גבוהה של בקרה, מעקב וניהול משימות ו-KPI.יכולת הכנת מצגות והצגת תובנות להנהלה בכירה.
יכולת ניתוח מבצעים, כדאיות וביצועים. היכרות עם כלי AI/Copilot - יתרון.
התפקיד כולל: שני כובעים -כובע מנהל /ת המטה (החלק הארגוני והניהולי)
 ניהול ותיאום פרויקטים: הובלת פרויקטים רוחביים בחטיבה (כמו הטמעת מערכת CRM חדשה, שינוי תהליכי שירות או השקת מבצעים).
 תכנון ובקרה תקציבית: מעקב אחר תקציב החטיבה, הקצאת משאבים וניתוח כדאיות כלכלית (ROI) של מהלכים שונים.
 סנכרון בין-ממשקי: תיווך וקישור בין חטיבת הלקוחות לחטיבות אחרות בארגון (כמו שיווק, כספים, מערכות מידע ומשפטית).
 הכנה לישיבות הנהלה: ריכוז החומרים המקצועיים, כתיבת מצגות להנהלה הבכירה וניסוח ניירות עמדה ותוכניות עבודה שנתיות/רבעוניות
דרישות:
 תפקיד אנליסט/ית ומנהל/ת מטה בחטיבת הלקוחות הוא תפקיד מפתח המשלב בין ניתוח נתונים מעמיק ( data Analytics) לבין ניהול, אופטימיזציה ותיאום של תהליכים עסקיים (Operations Strategy) בתוך חטיבה שאחראית על הקשר הישיר עם לקוחות החברה., התפקיד נועד להוות "יד ימינו" של הנהלת החטיבה.
ניתוח התנהגות לקוחות: זיהוי מגמות, ניתוח נטישה (Churn), מאפייני רכישה ושביעות רצון (NPS).
מעקב אחר מדדי ביצוע (KPIs): הגדרה, מדידה וניתוח של מדדי הצלחה חטיבתיים (כמו זמני מענה, אחוזי סגירת עסקאות, עמידה ביעדי מכירות).
בניית דוחות ודשבורדים: פיתוח כלי בקרה ממוחשבים (למשל ב-Tableau, Power BI או Excel) המציגים תמונת מצב בזמן אמת להנהלה.
איתור צווארי בקבוק: זיהוי כשלים בתהליכי השירות או המכירה והצעת פתרונות מבוססי נתונים.
.
***משרה מלאה- שכר 20-22 אלף +תנאים סוציאלים מעולים +יום עבודה מהבית+אש"ל המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Portfolio Management Analyst (Mat Leave Cover)
jobs.description:
OurCrowd is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Portfolio Management Analyst to join our Portfolio Management team on a temporary basis (6–8 months) as maternity leave cover. In this role, you'll provide hands-on operational and analytical support to the team. You'll keep portfolio data, reporting, and internal processes running smoothly across a diverse portfolio of innovative startups, with a focus on MedTech. This is an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to venture capital and portfolio management from the inside. This is a hybrid role, requiring three days in the office one day per week in our Jerusalem office and one day per week in our Tel Aviv office, and the third is flexible ; therefore, the position is posted in both locations. 
 The contract would go from January 1, 2027 until September 30, 2027 , with the potential to transition into a permanent role based on performance and business needs. 
Responsibilities: 
* Maintain and update portfolio company records, KPIs, and performance data across internal systems and CRM. 
* Track portfolio company updates, financial reports, and key milestones, and flag items that need the team's attention. 
* Prepare quarterly updates, performance reports, and internal materials, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and clarity. 
* Assist with data collection and analysis for due diligence processes. 
* Support the team with financial analysis, data gathering, and market research as needed. 
* Coordinate logistics for board meetings, portfolio reviews, investor updates, and internal meetings, including scheduling, materials, and follow-ups. 
* Manage document flow and records, including shareholder documents, reporting requests, and internal approvals. 
* Partner with legal, finance, marketing, and other cross-functional teams to keep investment and portfolio processes moving smoothly. 
* Help maintain and improve internal workflows, templates, and trackers to increase team efficiency. 
* Provide day-to-day support to the Portfolio Manager on ad-hoc projects and priorities.

 * Bachelor's degree in business, economics, life sciences, or a related field. 
* 1–2+ years' experience in an analyst, operations, finance, or business support role is an advantage; exposure to venture capital, private equity, or the startup ecosystem is an advantage. 
* Familiarity with the MedTech or life sciences sector is an advantage. 
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data and financial information. 
* Highly organized, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
* Strong English proficiency, with excellent written communication skills. 
* Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn new tools and systems. 
* Able to ramp up quickly and work independently with minimal hand-holding. 
* Available to commit to the full 6–8 month period, with the start date noted above.

jobs.title: Junior Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
At our company, youll collaborate with expert colleagues around the globe to solve problems most people will never even know exist!
Youll be part of building unique solutions shaped by real investigative methodologies, enabling our customers to identify, investigate, visualize and prevent criminal, terror and security threats worldwide.
These solutions are used by law enforcement, national security, and national and military intelligence agencies in almost 100 countries to turn massive, diverse data into clear, actionable intelligence for a safer world.
At our company, we are looking for a Junior Intelligence Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will combine investigative expertise, customer-facing engagement, and product knowledge to help customers maximize the value of our intelligence solutions. You will work closely with customers around the world, providing training, generating intelligence insights, and helping improve investigative methodologies and workflows.
As a worker you will:
Deliver product demonstrations, onboarding programs, workshops, and training sessions to customers and internal stakeholders worldwide.
Generate intelligence insights, investigations, and reports based on OSINT methodologies and analytical best practices.
Support customers in improving investigative workflows and achieving better operational outcomes through effective use of our company solutions.
Drive product adoption and user engagement by identifying usage trends, friction points, and opportunities for improvement.
Participate in product validation activities, including beta testing and feedback collection, ensuring new capabilities meet operational needs.
Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while collaborating closely with Product Management, Customer Success, and Sales teams.
Act as a voice of the customer by sharing field insights, emerging trends, and user requirements that help shape product enhancements and strategy.
Requirements: 
 1 year of experience as an Intelligence Analyst, Investigator, OSINT Analyst, or in a similar intelligence-related role (including relevant military intelligence experience).
Unit 8200 military service - advantage 
Strong analytical and investigative mindset with excellent attention to detail and the ability to translate findings into actionable insights.
Confidence presenting to audiences and delivering training sessions in a professional environment.
Native-level fluency in Spanish, French, or another European language.
Professional-level English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Ability to work independently while collaborating with global cross-functional teams.
Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 50% of the time.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: אנליסט.ית מלאי ובקרה
jobs.description:
אנליסט המלאי משלב חשיבה עסקית, אנליטית ותפעולית, ואחראי על אופטימיזציה של רמות המלאי בחברה, מניעת חוסרים ומקסום רווחיות. התפקיד מהווה את הגורם המרכזי לתחקור נתוני מכירות ומלאי, מתן מענה מהיר לניתוחי אד - הוק ובניית כלי עבודה יישומיים לעבודה שותפת ועבור ממשקים. בנוסף, התפקיד משמש כתובת תפעולית לריכוז ופתרון חוסרים מול המוסכים בשטח. 
 תחומי אחריות: תמיכה בקבלת החלטות אסטרטגיות מבוססות דאטה : הפקת דוחות ביצועים שוטפים, ניתוח ערכי מלאי מול תקציב, והצפת סיכונים ופערים להנהלה ולממשקים הרלוונטיים. איתור פערים בזמינות מוצרים: זיהוי חוסרים מתהווים או פערים בזמינות חלפים במוסכים, ומתן פתרונות מיידיים לשיפור רמת השירות. ניהול וריכוז חוסרים מול המוסכים: משמש ככתובת המרכזית עבור המוסכים בשטח; מתכלל את הבקשות, מנתח סיבות שורש ומקדם פתרונות. ניתוח חודשי מלאי, מלאי מת ואיטי: בקרת עלויות החזקת מלאי, איתור פריטים עודפים ("כסף מת") וגיבוש המלצות אקטיביות לצמצומם. ניתוח נתוני מכירות והפקת תובנות אופרטיביות: מעקב אחר מגמות צריכה, קצבי מכירה ועונתיות, ותרגומם להמלצות תפעוליות לרכש ולתכנון המלאי. בניית כלי עבודה ודוחות בקרה: אפיון ופיתוח כלים יישומיים, מחשבונים ודוחות בעיקר באקסל ובמערכות BI כדי לייעל את העבודה היומיומית של המחלקה. טיוב דאטה : בקרת איכות הנתונים ועבודה מול ממשקים לעדכון ותחזוקה. הטמעת כלי AI לניתוח נתונים: זיהוי הזדמנויות לייעול תהליכי עבודה באמצעות כלי בינה מלאכותית (AI), ושילובם בניתוח נתונים, אוטומציה של משימות, פיתוח פתרונות עסקיים, יצירת דוחות ותובנות ותמיכה בקבלת החלטות.
דרישות:
 תואר ראשון: בכלכלה / הנדסת תעשייה וניהול / לוגיסטיקה ומערכות מידע - חובה. ניסיון בניתוח נתונים: ניסיון של שנתיים לפחות בעבודה עם בסיסי נתונים גדולים ומורכבים, ויכולת ניתוח והסקת מסקנות ברמה גבוהה - חובה. ניסיון בתחום המלאי: ניסיון קודם בתפקיד דומה בעולמות המלאי, הרכש, התפעול או האנליזה - יתרון משמעותי. רקע מענף הרכב: היכרות עם עולם החלפים, המוסכים או יבואני הרכב - יתרון בולט. שליטה ב-Excel ברמת מומחה: פונקציות מתקדמות, עבודה עם דאטה רחב ומורכב, ואוטומציה - חובה ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות ERP וBI: יתרון לSAP- ולמערכותBI ארגוניות - חובה. היכרות ועבודה עם כלי AI: ניסיון מעשי בשימוש בכלי בינה מלאכותית (AI) לצורך ניתוח נתונים, ייעול תהליכי עבודה, פיתוח פתרונות ואוטומציה של משימות - יתרון משמעותי. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
PassportCard Labs is where innovation meets impact. As the technological powerhouse behind PassportCard, we design and build cutting-edge solutions that revolutionize the insurance industry. Whether it's real-time claims payments or predictive analytics, our Labs team is at the forefront of driving change and shaping the future of insurance. Ready to innovate with us? We are looking for a Data Analyst with approximately 2 years of experience to join our team and help turn data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will analyze data from multiple sources, build reports and dashboards, identify trends and opportunities, and support data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will work closely with different business and data teams, helping translate business questions into clear and actionable analyses. 
 What you'll do 
* Gather, analyze, and interpret data from multiple internal and external sources. 
* Create and maintain BI reports and dashboards for business stakeholders. 
* Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights. 
* Perform ad-hoc analyses to support business and operational decisions. 
* Use SQL to extract, combine, and analyze data from different sources. 
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and develop data-driven solutions. 
* Support improvements to reporting processes, data quality, and analytical capabilities. 
* Present findings and recommendations to managers and business 
* stakeholders to help guide day-to-day decisions. 
Business Unit: 
Data
Requirements: 
 * Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. 
* 2+ years of experience in data analytics, BI, or a similar analytical role. 
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets. 
* Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar. 
* Experience with Python, Data Bricks, AI tools for agentic development (such as Claude, Cursor, or similar) for data analysis is an advantage. 
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
* Detail-oriented, curious, and proactive, with a big-picture mindset that connects data to the business behind it. 
* Collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal skills. 
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: מהנדס /ת נתונים
jobs.description:
לחברתנו המפתחת ומייצרת גלאים לראיית לילה וממוקמת במשגב דרוש/ה מהנדס/ת נתונים מומחה/ית בJMP. מהנדס/ת נתונים אחראי/ת על ניהול, עיבוד, ניתוח ופרשנות של נתוני ייצור והנדסה לצורך בקרה, אופטימיזציה ושיפור מתמיד של תהליכים. התפקיד כולל שימוש נרחב בתוכנת JMP וכתיבת סקריפטים ב- JSL לביצוע אנליזות סטטיסטיות מתקדמות, חקירת בעיות תהליכיות והצגת ממצאים ברורים ותומכי החלטה לצוותי ההנדסה והייצור. 
 תחומי אחריות עיקריים ניתוח סטטיסטי מתקדם: ביצוע אנליזות סטטיסטיות (Cp, Cpk, SPC, DOE), זיהוי מגמות וחריגות, חיזוי כשלים פוטנציאליים בתהליכים והפקת תובנות לשיפור מתמשך פיתוח שיטות וכלים: פיתוח מודלים אנליטיים והטמעת כלים מתקדמים לבקרת תהליכים ויזואליזציה ודיווח: בניית לוחות מחוונים ודוחות אינטראקטיביים ב- JMP ובכלי BI נוספים להצגת נתונים, מגמות ותובנות למהנדסים ולטכנאים הכנת מצגות ודוחות מבוססי נתונים: פיתוח מצגות ודוחות המשלבים ויזואליזציות, נרטיב מובנה והסברים טכניים להצגת ממצאים באופן ברור וממוקד. התוצרים ישמשו ככלי תומך החלטה לצוותי ההנדסה והייצור בקרת תהליכים: ביצוע בקרות SPC בזמן אמת, סיוע בזיהוי כשלים שיטתיים והגדרת כללי התרעה לאירועים חריגים בקווי הייצור 
 שיתוף פעולה ועבודת ממשקים הנדסה : תמיכה בצוותי הנדסה באפיון בעיות תהליכיות, ניתוח נתונים והצעת פתרונות סטטיסטיים לשיפור תהליכים ופרמטרים קריטיים ייצור: שיתוף פעולה עם צוותי ייצור בזיהוי חריגות, פתרון בעיות בזמן אמת ושיפור תפוקות באמצעות ניתוח נתונים
דרישות:
 תואר ראשון (B.Sc) בסטטיסטיקה / מתמטיקה / מערכות מידע ניסיון בניתוח נתונים כמותיים וסטטיסטיים שליטה מלאה בתוכנת JMP וכתיבת סקריפטים ב- JSL - חובה היכרות עם תהליכי ייצור בתעשיות מתקדמות חובה! שליטה בכלי ניתוח נוספים: Python / MATLAB / R שליטה בכלי BI (Power BI / Tableau / Dash) ידע ב- SQL ועבודה מול מסדי נתונים חשיבה אנליטית, ירידה לפרטים ויכולת הצגת תוצאות ברורה ניסיון בבקרת תהליכים (SPC, Six Sigma, DOE) ניסיון בפיתוח שיטות ניתוח או מודלים סטטיסטיים מתקדמים ניסיון בהובלת פרויקטים הנדסיים בתחום הנתונים יכולת עבודה בצוות רב-תחומי ותקשורת טובה עם צוותי הנדסה וייצור המשרה פונה לשני המינים המשרה מצריכה קבלת סיווג בטחוני המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

- תמיכה בקבלת החלטות אסטרטגיות מבוססות דאטה: הפקת דוחות ביצועים, ניתוח ערכי מלאי מול תקציב, והצפת סיכונים ופערים להנהלה ולממשקים.
- איתור פערים בזמינות מוצרים: זיהוי חוסרים מתהווים או פערים בזמינות חלפים במוסכים, ומתן פתרונות מיידיים.
- ניהול וריכוז חוסרים מול המוסכים: כתובת מרכזית בשטח; תכלול בקשות, ניתוח סיבות שורש וקידום פתרונות.
